title: Cloud sync
aboutHint: Oleafly keeps a copy of your Library projects and settings in your own Dropbox, so you can pick up where you left off on another computer. It syncs while Oleafly is open.
lead: Back up your Library projects to your own Dropbox and open them on your other computers.
syncsProjects: Projects in your Library and their files. Build output, the .git folder and Oleafly's own working folders are left out.
syncsSettings: Your settings, including AI instructions, personas and your custom dictionary.
syncsNotYet: Git history and checkpoints don't sync yet.
syncNever: AI chats, passwords and keys never leave this computer.
pasteInstead: Trouble signing in? Paste a code instead
pasteHint: Dropbox will show a code. Copy it and paste it here.
pastePreparing: Opening a new sign-in page in your browser
loadFailed: Couldn't load cloud sync. Try again.
syncOnHelp: Syncs while Oleafly is open. Turning this off stops syncing here only. Your other computers and your Dropbox don't change.

auto.label: Sync automatically
auto.description: Oleafly syncs a few seconds after you save and as soon as another computer changes your Dropbox. Turn this off to sync only when you click Sync now.

computer.label: Computer name
computer.description: Your other computers show this name, for example on a copy of a change you made here.

revoked: Dropbox access ended. Connect again to keep syncing.
quotaFull: Your Dropbox is full. New changes stay on this computer until there's space. To make room, turn off sync for large projects or remove them from Dropbox.

disconnectRow.label: Disconnect Dropbox
disconnectRow.description: Stops syncing on this computer and removes Oleafly's access to your Dropbox. Nothing is deleted, here or in Dropbox.

settingsUnreadable: Oleafly can't read the settings in your Dropbox. They won't sync until you replace them.

projects.title: Projects
projects.off: Sync is off on this computer
projects.offline: Couldn't reach Dropbox. Oleafly will try again.
projects.empty: No projects yet. Projects you create in your Library will sync.
projects.checkFailed: Couldn't load the projects in your Dropbox.
projects.linkedNote_one: {{count}} project opened from a folder isn't synced. Only projects in your Library are backed up.
projects.linkedNote_other: {{count}} projects opened from a folder aren't synced. Only projects in your Library are backed up.

row.conflictsHelp_one: This file changed here and on another computer before they synced, so Oleafly kept both. Keep what you need, then delete the copy.
row.conflictsHelp_other: These files changed here and on another computer before they synced, so Oleafly kept both. Keep what you need, then delete the copies.
row.heldMessage_one: {{count}} of {{total}} files was deleted here, so sync is paused to keep the copy in your Dropbox safe.
row.heldMessage_other: {{count}} of {{total}} files were deleted here, so sync is paused to keep the copy in your Dropbox safe.

skipReason.unsupportedName: Name that doesn't work on every computer
skipReason.duplicateName: Same name as another file apart from capitals

confirm.removeDescription: This deletes the copy in your Dropbox to free up space. The project stays on this computer and stops syncing here. Your other computers keep their copies.
confirm.removeRemoteDescription: This deletes the project from your Dropbox to free up space. It isn't on this computer, so you can't download it here afterwards. Computers that already have it keep their copies.
confirm.replaceTitle: Replace the copy of {{name}} in Dropbox?
confirm.replaceDescription: Oleafly can't read the copy in your Dropbox. It will be replaced with the copy on this computer, and anything that's only in Dropbox will be lost.
confirm.deleteTitle: Delete these files from Dropbox too?
confirm.deleteDescription_one: The file you deleted from {{name}} on this computer will also be deleted from your Dropbox. Other computers that sync this project will lose it too.
confirm.deleteDescription_other: The {{count}} files you deleted from {{name}} on this computer will also be deleted from your Dropbox. Other computers that sync this project will lose them too.
confirm.disconnectDescription: Syncing stops on this computer. Your projects stay on this computer and in your Dropbox.

choice.title: Which settings should Oleafly use?
choice.description: Your Dropbox has settings from another computer, and they're different from the ones here. Pick the set you want. Your other computers will use it too.

toast.restored: {{name}} is back from the Recycle Bin.
toast.removed: {{name}} was removed from your Dropbox. It's still on this computer.
toast.replaced: {{name}} in your Dropbox now matches this computer.
toast.filesRestored: The deleted files are back in {{name}}.
toast.filesDeleted: The deleted files were removed from your Dropbox too.

errors.code_invalid: That code didn't work. Try again.
errors.device_name_invalid: A computer name can't contain \ / : * ? " < > | or control characters, and it can be at most 32 characters long.
errors.disabled: Sync is turned off on this computer.
errors.disk_full: This computer is running out of disk space. Free up some space to keep syncing.
errors.download_missing: Some files of this project are missing from Dropbox, so it wasn't downloaded.
errors.local_io: Oleafly couldn't read or write a file in this project. It will try again on the next sync.
errors.network: Couldn't reach Dropbox. Check your connection.
errors.newer_version: This project was synced by a newer version of Oleafly. Update Oleafly to keep syncing it.
errors.not_found: This project is no longer in your Dropbox.
errors.project_busy: This project was in use, so it will sync next time.
errors.quota_full: Your Dropbox is full. New changes stay on this computer until there's space.
errors.rate_limited: Dropbox asked Oleafly to slow down. Sync will try again shortly.
errors.remote_busy: Another computer was syncing this project at the same time. It will sync again shortly.
errors.remote_unreadable: Oleafly can't read the copy in your Dropbox, so this project isn't syncing.
errors.revoked: Dropbox access was revoked. Connect again.
errors.server: Dropbox had a problem. Sync will try again shortly.
errors.sign_in_timeout: Sign-in took too long. Try again.
errors.too_many_files: This project has more than 100,000 files. That's too many to sync.
errors.verify_failed: A file from Dropbox didn't match what Oleafly expected, so it was left alone. Sync will try again.
